gloss: master and disciple; teacher and student

definitions.gloss: master and disciple; teacher and student
definitions.explanation: Refers to the relationship between a teacher/master and their student/disciple. Emphasizes the traditional, often deep personal bond in mentorship.

examples.japanese: {師弟|してい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。

examples.english: Their master-student relationship has lasted over 30 years.

examples.japanese: {師弟|してい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧、⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{師|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The bond between master and disciple is deep, and the disciple still cherishes the master's teachings.

notes:
Composed of {師|し} (master/teacher) + {弟|てい} (disciple/younger), referring to the pair of teacher and student together. Implies a traditional mentorship bond, often in arts, martial arts, crafts, or academic disciplines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {師弟|してい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: master-disciple relationship
- {師弟|してい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧: the bond between master and student
- {師弟|してい}⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: love/affection between master and student
- {師弟|してい}⟦{対決|たいけつ}→対決：12392_taiketsu⟧: a showdown between master and pupil

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese culture, the {師弟|してい}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ carries deep significance, especially in traditional arts (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧, ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧, ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧), martial arts, and apprenticeship-based crafts. The relationship often extends beyond mere instruction to include personal guidance and lifelong respect.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧: disciple/pupil — the student only
- ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧: master/teacher — the teacher only
- ⟦{門下生|もんかせい}→門下生：17733_monkasei⟧: student under a master — the disciple viewed from the school's perspective
